newsitem.title: USA: NFO Research buys MBL Group for $55 mln.
newsitem.headline: NFO Research buys MBL Group for $55 mln.

text.p: NFO Research Inc said Monday it agreed to buy market research firm MBL Group Plc in a deal valued at $55 million.
NFO said it bought all the outstanding stock of the MBL Group through a new issue of about 1.36 million shares valued at about $32.3 million.
NFO also said it also agreed to buy a portion of the shares of various MBL operating companies held by minority shareholder employees in 1997, and the remainder within three years.

A company spokesman estimated the total purchase price at $55 million and said NFO will have paid $47 million --1.5 million shares plus $11.1 million in cash (excluding deal costs)-- by the year's end.
He said NFO will pay an additional $8 million in three years, possibly more if the affiliates hit certain benchmarks.
The deal ups NFO's oustanding shares to about 12 million from an average of about 10.5 million in the first quarter.

NFO said it expected the acquisition to have a positive effect on its 1997 earnings. It added MBL, which has 27 offices in 17 countries, posted about $45 million in total revenues last year (assuming full consolidation of its subsidiaries and affiliates).
NFO reported a $1.95 million net income on revenues of about $30.1 million in the first quarter, compared with a $1.70 million net on revenues of $24.1 million the year before.
The company's stock traded at 22 Monday afternoon, down 3/4.
